Deterministic random tiny Hunyuan checkpoint and FP32 reference logits, generated by `scripts/hy_mt_reference.py` with seed 773 using the official Transformers HunYuanDenseV1ForCausalLM implementation. This fixture contains no pretrained model weights. It exercises rotated Q/K RMSNorm, fixed-alpha NTK RoPE, grouped-query attention, cached decoding and branching. Regenerate from the repository root with `python scripts/hy_mt_reference.py --output crates/hy-mt/tests/fixtures/hunyuan` in the reference environment defined by `scripts/requirements-hy-mt-reference.txt`.
